title: Split Array Largest Sum
statement: Split `nums` into `k` non-empty contiguous parts. Return the minimum possible largest sum among the parts.
hints: The answer lies between the largest element and the total sum.
A candidate maximum sum is feasible when a greedy scan can cover the array in at most k parts without exceeding it.
Binary search the candidate. Feasibility is monotone.

approaches.name: DP
approaches.explanation: dp[parts][index] is the best largest sum.

approaches.name: Binary search on the sum
approaches.explanation: The same pattern as shipping packages.

editorial: If a maximum part sum M is feasible, every larger M is feasible. Greedily fill a part until the next element would exceed M, then start a new part. If the number of parts is at most k, search lower. The lowest feasible M is the answer, and it is at least the heaviest element.

examples.explanation: The split 1+2+3 and 4+5 has largest sum 9.
